import html # Predefined HTML template for blog posts. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Prepare a blog post for web display by escaping user input to prevent XSS and inserting it into the predefined HTML template. Parameters: headline (str): The main heading of the blog post. content (str): The full textual content of the blog post. Returns: str: A fully sanitized and formatted HTML string ready for rendering. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to neutralize malicious scripts. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Optionally convert newlines in content to
tags for formatting. safe_content = safe_content.replace('\n', '
\n') # Insert the sanitized values into the template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content)
